analysis.headline: Nvidia investigates Huang's ties to alleged Chinese spy after affair memo
analysis.summary: Nvidia's board announced an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, reportedly recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to spy on the company, after reports from The New York Times and the Financial Times. Huang sent staff a memo acknowledging the affair. One outlet's lede described the woman only as a business client, while others identified her as a suspected Chinese intelligence operative.
